values.note: Online through the park's Checkfront engine; full payment at booking; cancel up to 7 days before arrival (C$12 fee). One unit per site; a second unit (RV or tent) is C$28 a night, two units maximum. Group and long-term bookings by phone (1-866-440-3500). Check-in after 4 pm, check-out before 2 pm.

note: Large private RV park at the Aspen Crossing heritage railway near Mossleigh, beside The Station gift store and garden centre and a dining car restaurant: big-rig friendly, group camping, caboose cabins, playground, camp hosts, a sand-beach swimming lagoon (Sunrise Lagoon) and Pequito Pond. Campers get 20% off regular train excursions. --Claude
